Fist Eostre is a human wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.
“
A rabid worg organised this inventory, judging by the mess they've left me.
„
— Eostre

Involvement

Eostre is wandering back and forth around the Basilisk Gate Barracks, being tasked with checking and reorgainizing the inventory, particularly the food supplies. She comments on this angrily if spoken with or while making another round between stacks and boxes. She does not want to be bothered until she finishes the task.
